section.p: Consider a "Database Port Reference" chapter in a "System Administration Reference Guide" document where you want the table to display a visible title in output.
section.codeblock:
Database Port Reference Default database services communicate through predefined network ports.

The following table lists the default ports used by supported database platforms.

Default Database Ports Database Default Port Description PostgreSQL 5432 Default PostgreSQL listener port. MySQL 3306 Default MySQL and MariaDB listener port. Oracle Database 1521 Oracle Net Listener default port.
section.p: Result: Use a CALS <table> instead of <simpletable> when the table requires a caption, advanced formatting, spanning, nested tables, and precise column control.
